title: The Emergence of Lab-Driven Alignment Signatures: A Psychometric Framework for Auditing Latent Bias and Compounding Risk in Generative AI
abstract: arXiv:2602.17127v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models increasingly serve as reasoning layers in multi-agent systems, where one provider's models may generate, judge, and summarize within a single pipeline. This raises the question of whether developer organizations impart durable behavioral tendencies that could compound across such stacks.   We apply a scenario-based forced-choice instrument to 18 governance-relevant behavioral dimensions across 18 models from six developer organizations. Items are model-generated, filtered by independent judges, and administered with probe blanks embedded among semantically orthogonal decoys under deterministic option shuffling. Findings are declared on effect size, requiring both Holm-corrected significance and |d| >= 0.2. translated_title: 实验室驱动的对齐特征浮现：一种用于审计生成式AI中潜在偏见与复合风险的心理测量框架
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型日益作为多智能体系统中的推理层，其中单一提供商的模型可能在同一管道内生成、评判和总结内容。这引发了开发者组织是否会灌输持久的行为倾向，从而在此类堆栈中复合的问题。我们采用基于场景的强制选择工具，对来自六个开发者组织的18个模型，在18个治理相关行为维度上进行评估。测试项由模型生成，经独立评审者筛选，并在确定性选项洗牌下，将探测空白嵌入语义正交的干扰项中。研究结果以效应量报告，要求同时满足霍尔姆校正显著性和|d| >= 0.2。在14个维度中，其中一个尺度极点表示定义的响应失败——如奉承、虚假平衡、过度自信等——组织占据一致的相对位置（肯德尔W系数）。
tldr: 本文提出一种心理测量框架，通过强制选择工具审计18个模型在18个治理维度上的潜在偏见，发现不同开发者组织在响应失败维度上呈现一致的相对位置，揭示了多智能体系统中偏见复合的风险。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a psychometric framework using forced-choice instruments to audit latent biases across 18 models, revealing consistent organizational positioning on response-failure dimensions and highlighting compounding risk in multi-agent systems.
